steps.code:
# Let's process all files: read content, derive title, and create notes.
sn_token = sn_login['access_token']
file_paths = apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=fs_token, directory_path='/home/glen/documents/personal/simple_note/', entry_type='files')

for path in file_paths:
    # Read file content
    file_data = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=path)
    content = file_data['content']
    
    # Derive title: basename without .md, replace underscores with spaces
    filename = path.split('/')[-1]
    title = filename[:-3]  # remove .md
    title = title.replace('_', ' ')
    
    # Create note
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(title=title, content=content, access_token=sn_token)
    print(f"Created note for {filename} -> {result}")
